name: ExtMedicationRequestOpiumActClassification
title: Opiumwet classification (G-Standaard bijzonder kenmerk)
description: Indicates that the prescribed product falls under the Dutch Opiumwet, as a G-Standaard bijzonder kenmerk (bestand BST401T, thesaurus BST922T). Carried as a CodeableConcept rather than a boolean because code 2 ('in volle omvang') and code 65 ('afhandeling als UR') have materially different consequences for a dispensing pharmacist. Neither nl-core nor Medicatieproces 9 defines an equivalent; base R4 places drug scheduling on MedicationKnowledge.regulatory.schedule, which is a catalogue resource and not present in a prescription result.

element.comment: Absent means the product is not known to fall under the Opiumwet. Prescriptor currently reports only a yes/no flag, which corresponds to bijzonder kenmerk rubriek 72 nr 2, so only code 2 is emitted today; codes 65 and 107 can be added without a breaking change.
